Other tiles keep their positions while t.ko: 새 창이 들어와도 다른 영역의 창은 제자리를 유지해요.
Other tiles keep their positions while t.ja: 新しいウインドウが入っても、ほかの領域の配置は変わりません。
Other tiles keep their positions while t.zh-Hans: 新窗口加入时，其他区域的窗口保持原位。
Other tiles keep their positions while t.zh-Hant: 新視窗加入時，其他區域的視窗保持原位。

Closing a window lets the remaining tile.en: Closing a window lets the remaining tiles fill the space.
Closing a window lets the remaining tile.ko: 창을 닫으면 남은 창이 빈 공간을 채워요.
Closing a window lets the remaining tile.ja: ウインドウを閉じると、残ったウインドウが空いた領域を埋めます。
Closing a window lets the remaining tile.zh-Hans: 关闭窗口后，其余窗口会填满腾出的空间。
Closing a window lets the remaining tile.zh-Hant: 關閉視窗後，其餘視窗會填滿空出的空間。

Swap the focused window with the window.en: Swap the focused window with the window beside it.
Swap the focused window with the window.ko: 선택한 창과 옆 창의 위치를 바꿔요.
Swap the focused window with the window.ja: 選択中のウインドウと隣のウインドウを入れ替えます。
Swap the focused window with the window.zh-Hans: 交换当前选中窗口与相邻窗口的位置。
Swap the focused window with the window.zh-Hant: 交換目前選取視窗與相鄰視窗的位置。

Switch between left/right and top/bottom.en: Switch between left/right and top/bottom splits.
Switch between left/right and top/bottom.ko: 창을 나누는 방향을 좌우에서 위아래로 바꿔요.
Switch between left/right and top/bottom.ja: 左右分割と上下分割を切り替えます。
Switch between left/right and top/bottom.zh-Hans: 在左右分割和上下分割之间切换。
Switch between left/right and top/bottom.zh-Hant: 在左右分割與上下分割之間切換。

Grow the focused tile along its current.en: Grow the focused tile along its current split.
Grow the focused tile along its current.ko: 선택한 창이 속한 영역을 더 크게 늘려요.
Grow the focused tile along its current.ja: 選択中のウインドウの領域を広げます。
Grow the focused tile along its current.zh-Hans: 扩大当前选中窗口所占的区域。
Grow the focused tile along its current.zh-Hant: 擴大目前選取視窗所占的區域。

Balance resets the BSP layout when Auto-.en: Balance resets the BSP layout when Auto-balance is off.
Balance resets the BSP layout when Auto-.ko: 자동 균등 배치가 꺼져 있으면 기본 BSP 배치로 되돌려요.
Balance resets the BSP layout when Auto-.ja: 自動均等配置がオフの場合、基本の BSP 配置に戻します。
Balance resets the BSP layout when Auto-.zh-Hans: 关闭自动均衡时，均衡命令会恢复默认 BSP 布局。
Balance resets the BSP layout when Auto-.zh-Hant: 關閉自動平衡時，平衡指令會恢復預設 BSP 排列。

Drag onto another window to swap or repo.en: Drag onto another window to swap or reposition it.
Drag onto another window to swap or repo.ko: 창을 다른 창 위로 드래그해 위치를 바꾸거나 끼워 넣어요.
Drag onto another window to swap or repo.ja: 別のウインドウへドラッグして、入れ替えたり隣へ配置したりできます。
Drag onto another window to swap or repo.zh-Hans: 将窗口拖到另一个窗口上，交换位置或插入布局。
Drag onto another window to swap or repo.zh-Hant: 將視窗拖到另一個視窗上，交換位置或插入排列。

Drag a window edge; Tatami saves the new.en: Drag a window edge; Tatami saves the new split ratio.
Drag a window edge; Tatami saves the new.ko: 창 가장자리를 드래그하면 바꾼 비율이 저장돼요.
Drag a window edge; Tatami saves the new.ja: ウインドウの端をドラッグすると、変更した分割比率が保存されます。
Drag a window edge; Tatami saves the new.zh-Hans: 拖动窗口边缘，Tatami 会保存新的分割比例。
Drag a window edge; Tatami saves the new.zh-Hant: 拖曳視窗邊緣，Tatami 會儲存新的分割比例。

Enlarge one tile without losing the save.en: Enlarge one tile without losing the saved layout.
Enlarge one tile without losing the save.ko: 기존 배치를 유지한 채 창 하나만 크게 확대해요.
Enlarge one tile without losing the save.ja: 元の配置を保ったまま、一つのウインドウを大きく表示できます。
Enlarge one tile without losing the save.zh-Hans: 放大一个窗口，同时保留原来的布局。
Enlarge one tile without losing the save.zh-Hant: 放大一個視窗，同時保留原本的排列。

Press the shortcut again to restore the.en: Press the shortcut again to restore the previous layout.
Press the shortcut again to restore the.ko: 같은 단축키를 다시 누르면 이전 배치로 돌아와요.
Press the shortcut again to restore the.ja: 同じショートカットをもう一度押すと、元の配置に戻ります。
Press the shortcut again to restore the.zh-Hans: 再按一次快捷键，恢复之前的布局。
Press the shortcut again to restore the.zh-Hant: 再按一次快速鍵，恢復先前的排列。

Select a window with a shortcut; the poi.en: Select a window with a shortcut; the pointer moves there too.
Select a window with a shortcut; the poi.ko: 단축키로 창을 선택하면 마우스 포인터도 그 창으로 이동해요.
Select a window with a shortcut; the poi.ja: ショートカットでウインドウを選ぶと、ポインタもそのウインドウへ移動します。
Select a window with a shortcut; the poi.zh-Hans: 用快捷键选中窗口时，鼠标指针也会移到该窗口。
Select a window with a shortcut; the poi.zh-Hant: 用快速鍵選取視窗時，滑鼠游標也會移到該視窗。

With Focus Follows Mouse enabled, hoveri.en: With Focus Follows Mouse enabled, hovering selects a window.
With Focus Follows Mouse enabled, hoveri.ko: 마우스 포인터를 올린 창을 자동으로 선택하도록 설정할 수도 있어요.
With Focus Follows Mouse enabled, hoveri.ja: ポインタを重ねたウインドウが自動で選ばれる設定もあります。
With Focus Follows Mouse enabled, hoveri.zh-Hans: 启用焦点跟随鼠标后，指针移入哪个窗口就选中哪个窗口。
With Focus Follows Mouse enabled, hoveri.zh-Hant: 啟用焦點跟隨滑鼠後，游標移入哪個視窗就選取哪個視窗。

When a window closes, focus moves to a r.en: When a window closes, focus moves to a remaining window.
When a window closes, focus moves to a r.ko: 창을 닫으면 남아 있는 창이 자동으로 선택돼요.
When a window closes, focus moves to a r.ja: ウインドウを閉じると、残っているウインドウへフォーカスが移ります。
When a window closes, focus moves to a r.zh-Hans: 关闭窗口后，自动选中剩下的窗口。
When a window closes, focus moves to a r.zh-Hant: 關閉視窗後，自動選取剩下的視窗。

Hold the shortcut to choose a window in.en: Hold the shortcut to choose a window in the current workspace.
Hold the shortcut to choose a window in.ko: 단축키를 길게 눌러 현재 작업 공간의 창을 골라요.
Hold the shortcut to choose a window in.ja: ショートカットを押し続けて、今のワークスペースのウインドウを選びます。
Hold the shortcut to choose a window in.zh-Hans: 按住快捷键，选择当前工作区中的窗口。
Hold the shortcut to choose a window in.zh-Hant: 按住快速鍵，選擇目前工作空間中的視窗。

Tap the shortcut to return to the last-u.en: Tap the shortcut to return to the last-used window.
Tap the shortcut to return to the last-u.ko: 단축키를 짧게 누르면 직전에 사용한 창으로 돌아가요.
Tap the shortcut to return to the last-u.ja: 短く押すと、直前に使っていたウインドウへ戻ります。
Tap the shortcut to return to the last-u.zh-Hans: 轻按快捷键，返回上一个使用的窗口。
Tap the shortcut to return to the last-u.zh-Hant: 輕按快速鍵，返回上一個使用的視窗。

Borrow another workspace without leaving.en: Borrow another workspace without leaving the current task.
Borrow another workspace without leaving.ko: 현재 작업을 유지하면서 다른 작업 공간을 옆에 빌려와요.
Borrow another workspace without leaving.ja: 今の作業を続けながら、別のワークスペースを隣へ借りられます。
Borrow another workspace without leaving.zh-Hans: 无需离开当前任务，就能借用另一个工作区。
Borrow another workspace without leaving.zh-Hant: 不必離開目前工作，就能借用另一個工作空間。

Dismiss the borrowed workspace to restor.en: Dismiss the borrowed workspace to restore the full layout.
Dismiss the borrowed workspace to restor.ko: 빌려온 작업 공간을 돌려보내면 원래 영역을 다시 채워요.
Dismiss the borrowed workspace to restor.ja: 借りたワークスペースを閉じると、元の領域全体を使えます。
Dismiss the borrowed workspace to restor.zh-Hans: 收起借用的工作区，恢复完整布局。
Dismiss the borrowed workspace to restor.zh-Hant: 收起借用的工作空間，恢復完整排列。

A scratchpad opens only when you borrow.en: A scratchpad opens only when you borrow it.
A scratchpad opens only when you borrow.ko: 임시 작업 공간은 빌려올 때만 열려요.
A scratchpad opens only when you borrow.ja: スクラッチパッドは、借りる操作でのみ表示できます。
A scratchpad opens only when you borrow.zh-Hans: 临时工作区只在借用时打开。
A scratchpad opens only when you borrow.zh-Hant: 暫存工作空間只會在借用時開啟。

Borrow the scratchpad again; its apps ke.en: Borrow the scratchpad again; its apps keep their contents.
Borrow the scratchpad again; its apps ke.ko: 다시 빌려와도 앱에서 작업한 내용은 그대로 남아 있어요.
Borrow the scratchpad again; its apps ke.ja: もう一度借りると、アプリの作業内容がそのまま残っています。
Borrow the scratchpad again; its apps ke.zh-Hans: 再次借用时，应用中的内容仍然保留。
Borrow the scratchpad again; its apps ke.zh-Hant: 再次借用時，App 中的內容仍然保留。

Choose which edge to place the borrowed.en: Choose which edge to place the borrowed workspace on.
Choose which edge to place the borrowed.ko: 빌려온 작업 공간을 화면의 어느 쪽에 둘지 골라요.
Choose which edge to place the borrowed.ja: 借りるワークスペースを、画面のどの辺に置くか選べます。
Choose which edge to place the borrowed.zh-Hans: 选择将借用的工作区放在屏幕的哪一侧。
Choose which edge to place the borrowed.zh-Hant: 選擇將借用的工作空間放在螢幕的哪一側。

Borrow can also place a workspace below.en: Borrow can also place a workspace below the current one.
Borrow can also place a workspace below.ko: 현재 작업 공간 아래쪽으로 빌려올 수도 있어요.
Borrow can also place a workspace below.ja: 今のワークスペースの下側に借りることもできます。
Borrow can also place a workspace below.zh-Hans: 也可以把借用的工作区放在当前工作区下方。
Borrow can also place a workspace below.zh-Hant: 也可以將借用的工作空間放在目前工作空間下方。

Activate the borrowed workspace to switc.en: Activate the borrowed workspace to switch to it completely.
Activate the borrowed workspace to switc.ko: 빌려온 작업 공간을 활성화하면 그 공간으로 완전히 전환해요.
Activate the borrowed workspace to switc.ja: 借りているワークスペースを開くと、その作業へ完全に切り替わります。
Activate the borrowed workspace to switc.zh-Hans: 激活借用的工作区，就会完全切换过去。
Activate the borrowed workspace to switc.zh-Hant: 啟用借用的工作空間，就會完全切換過去。

Always on Top keeps this window above th.en: Always on Top keeps this window above the workspace.
Always on Top keeps this window above th.ko: 항상 위로 설정한 창은 작업 공간 위에 계속 보여요.
Always on Top keeps this window above th.ja: 最前面表示にしたウインドウは、ワークスペースの手前に表示されます。
Always on Top keeps this window above th.zh-Hans: 设为始终置顶的窗口会保持在工作区上方。
Always on Top keeps this window above th.zh-Hant: 設為保持最上層的視窗，會持續顯示在工作空間上方。

Switch to tiled placement to include the.en: Switch to tiled placement to include the window in the layout.
Switch to tiled placement to include the.ko: 타일링으로 바꾸면 다른 창과 함께 나눠 배치돼요.
Switch to tiled placement to include the.ja: タイル表示に切り替えると、ほかのウインドウと並んで配置されます。
Switch to tiled placement to include the.zh-Hans: 切换为平铺，让窗口参与自动布局。
Switch to tiled placement to include the.zh-Hant: 切換為並排，讓視窗加入自動排列。

Switch back to Always on Top whenever yo.en: Switch back to Always on Top whenever you need it.
Switch back to Always on Top whenever yo.ko: 필요할 때 다시 항상 위로 바꿀 수 있어요.
Switch back to Always on Top whenever yo.ja: 必要なときに、再び最前面表示へ戻せます。
Switch back to Always on Top whenever yo.zh-Hans: 需要时，可以再次切换为始终置顶。
Switch back to Always on Top whenever yo.zh-Hant: 需要時，可以再次切換為保持最上層。

A shared Always on Top window stays visi.en: A shared Always on Top window stays visible across workspaces.
A shared Always on Top window stays visi.ko: 공용 앱을 항상 위로 두면 어느 작업 공간에서도 보여요.
A shared Always on Top window stays visi.ja: 共有アプリを最前面表示にすると、どのワークスペースでも表示されます。
A shared Always on Top window stays visi.zh-Hans: 将共享应用设为始终置顶，在每个工作区都能看到它。
A shared Always on Top window stays visi.zh-Hant: 將共用 App 設為保持最上層，在每個工作空間都能看到它。

The shared window remains visible even o.en: The shared window remains visible even over a zoomed tile.
The shared window remains visible even o.ko: 창 하나를 전체 크기로 확대해도 공용 창은 계속 보여요.
The shared window remains visible even o.ja: 一つのウインドウを拡大しても、共有ウインドウは手前に表示されます。
The shared window remains visible even o.zh-Hans: 即使放大一个平铺窗口，共享窗口仍然可见。
The shared window remains visible even o.zh-Hant: 即使放大一個並排視窗，共用視窗仍然可見。

Leave As Is keeps a window out of automa.en: Leave As Is keeps a window out of automatic tiling.
Leave As Is keeps a window out of automa.ko: 그대로 두기로 설정한 창은 자동 타일링에서 제외돼요.
Leave As Is keeps a window out of automa.ja: そのまま表示にしたウインドウは、自動タイル配置の対象外になります。
Leave As Is keeps a window out of automa.zh-Hans: 设为保持原样的窗口不参与自动平铺。
Leave As Is keeps a window out of automa.zh-Hant: 設為維持原狀的視窗不會參與自動並排。

Shared membership keeps it in place when.en: Shared membership keeps it in place when workspaces change.
Shared membership keeps it in place when.ko: 공용 앱으로 등록하면 작업 공간을 바꿔도 위치와 크기가 유지돼요.
Shared membership keeps it in place when.ja: 共有アプリにすると、ワークスペースを変えても位置と大きさを保てます。
Shared membership keeps it in place when.zh-Hans: 设为共享应用后，切换工作区也会保持它的位置和大小。
Shared membership keeps it in place when.zh-Hant: 設為共用 App 後，切換工作空間也會保留它的位置與大小。

The CLI can list workspaces and control.en: The CLI can list workspaces and control the running Tatami.
The CLI can list workspaces and control.ko: CLI로 작업 공간 목록을 확인하고 실행 중인 Tatami를 조작해요.
The CLI can list workspaces and control.ja: CLI からワークスペース一覧を確認し、起動中の Tatami を操作できます。
The CLI can list workspaces and control.zh-Hans: 通过 CLI 查看工作区列表并控制正在运行的 Tatami。
The CLI can list workspaces and control.zh-Hant: 透過 CLI 查看工作空間清單，並操作執行中的 Tatami。

One script activates, arranges, and borr.en: One script activates, arranges, and borrows workspaces.
One script activates, arranges, and borr.ko: 스크립트 하나로 작업 공간 전환·배치·빌려오기를 실행해요.
One script activates, arranges, and borr.ja: 一つのスクリプトで、ワークスペースの切り替え・配置・借用を実行します。
One script activates, arranges, and borr.zh-Hans: 一个脚本即可切换、排列和借用工作区。
One script activates, arranges, and borr.zh-Hant: 一個指令稿即可切換、排列及借用工作空間。

Hooks notify external tools when the wor.en: Hooks notify external tools when the workspace changes.
Hooks notify external tools when the wor.ko: 작업 공간이 바뀌면 훅으로 외부 도구에 알려요.
Hooks notify external tools when the wor.ja: ワークスペースが変わると、フックで外部ツールに通知できます。
Hooks notify external tools when the wor.zh-Hans: 工作区变化时，通过钩子通知外部工具。
Hooks notify external tools when the wor.zh-Hant: 工作空間變更時，透過掛鉤通知外部工具。

HUD hooks also send action feedback to e.en: HUD hooks also send action feedback to external tools.
HUD hooks also send action feedback to e.ko: HUD 훅으로 동작 알림도 외부 도구에 전달해요.
HUD hooks also send action feedback to e.ja: HUD フックを使うと、操作結果の通知も外部ツールへ送れます。
HUD hooks also send action feedback to e.zh-Hans: HUD 钩子还能把操作提示发送给外部工具。
HUD hooks also send action feedback to e.zh-Hant: HUD 掛鉤也能將操作提示傳送給外部工具。

Edit TOML to change window gaps while Ta.en: Edit TOML to change window gaps while Tatami is running.
Edit TOML to change window gaps while Ta.ko: 실행 중에 TOML 파일을 수정해 창 사이 간격을 바꿔요.
Edit TOML to change window gaps while Ta.ja: Tatami の起動中に TOML を編集して、ウインドウの間隔を変えられます。
Edit TOML to change window gaps while Ta.zh-Hans: Tatami 运行时，编辑 TOML 即可调整窗口间距。
Edit TOML to change window gaps while Ta.zh-Hant: Tatami 執行時，編輯 TOML 即可調整視窗間距。

Supported settings reload automatically.en: Supported settings reload automatically without restarting.
Supported settings reload automatically.ko: 지원하는 설정은 재시작하지 않아도 자동으로 반영돼요.
Supported settings reload automatically.ja: 対応している設定は、再起動せずに自動で反映されます。
Supported settings reload automatically.zh-Hans: 支持的设置会自动生效，无需重启。
Supported settings reload automatically.zh-Hant: 支援的設定會自動生效，不必重新啟動。

Pin different workspaces to different di.en: Pin different workspaces to different displays.
Pin different workspaces to different di.ko: 화면마다 다른 작업 공간을 고정해 사용할 수 있어요.
Pin different workspaces to different di.ja: ディスプレイごとに、別のワークスペースを固定できます。
Pin different workspaces to different di.zh-Hans: 将不同的工作区固定到不同的显示器。
Pin different workspaces to different di.zh-Hant: 將不同的工作空間固定至不同的顯示器。

One shortcut restores the previous works.en: One shortcut restores the previous workspace pair.
One shortcut restores the previous works.ko: 단축키 하나로 이전에 함께 쓰던 작업 공간들로 돌아와요.
One shortcut restores the previous works.ja: ショートカット一つで、前のワークスペースの組み合わせに戻れます。
One shortcut restores the previous works.zh-Hans: 一个快捷键，恢复之前搭配使用的工作区。
One shortcut restores the previous works.zh-Hant: 一個快速鍵，恢復先前搭配使用的工作空間。

Connect a second display to trigger the.en: Connect a second display to trigger the two-display profile rule.
Connect a second display to trigger the.ko: 두 번째 화면을 연결하면 두 화면용 프로필이 자동으로 켜져요.
Connect a second display to trigger the.ja: 2 台目を接続すると、2 画面用の条件でプロファイルが自動切り替えされます。
Connect a second display to trigger the.zh-Hans: 连接第二个显示器，自动触发双屏配置方案。
Connect a second display to trigger the.zh-Hant: 連接第二部顯示器，自動啟用雙螢幕的設定組合。

Disconnect it to trigger the single-disp.en: Disconnect it to trigger the single-display profile rule.
Disconnect it to trigger the single-disp.ko: 연결을 해제하면 한 화면용 프로필로 자동 전환돼요.
Disconnect it to trigger the single-disp.ja: 接続を外すと、1 画面用のプロファイルに自動で戻ります。
Disconnect it to trigger the single-disp.zh-Hans: 断开连接，自动切换回单屏配置方案。
Disconnect it to trigger the single-disp.zh-Hant: 中斷連接，自動切換回單螢幕的設定組合。

Edit the saved layout before activating.en: Edit the saved layout before activating the workspace.
Edit the saved layout before activating.ko: 작업 공간을 켜기 전에 저장된 창 배치를 편집해요.
Edit the saved layout before activating.ja: ワークスペースを開く前に、保存するウインドウ配置を編集できます。
Edit the saved layout before activating.zh-Hans: 激活工作区之前，先编辑保存的窗口布局。
Edit the saved layout before activating.zh-Hant: 啟用工作空間之前，先編輯儲存的視窗排列。

Flip the top and bottom positions in the.en: Flip the top and bottom positions in the layout preview.
Flip the top and bottom positions in the.ja: 配置プレビューで、上下の位置を入れ替えます。
Flip the top and bottom positions in the.zh-Hans: 在布局预览中交换上下位置。
Flip the top and bottom positions in the.zh-Hant: 在排列預覽中交換上下位置。

Activating the workspace applies the lay.en: Activating the workspace applies the layout you just edited.
Activating the workspace applies the lay.ko: 작업 공간을 켜면 방금 편집한 배치가 실제 창에 적용돼요.
Activating the workspace applies the lay.ja: ワークスペースを開くと、編集した配置が実際のウインドウに反映されます。
Activating the workspace applies the lay.zh-Hans: 激活工作区后，刚才编辑的布局会应用到实际窗口。
Activating the workspace applies the lay.zh-Hant: 啟用工作空間後，剛才編輯的排列會套用至實際視窗。

Guided Setup lets you practise without m.en: Guided Setup lets you practise without moving your real windows.
Guided Setup lets you practise without m.ko: 가이드 설정에서는 실제 창을 움직이지 않고 기능을 연습해요.
Guided Setup lets you practise without m.ja: ガイド付き設定では、実際のウインドウを動かさずに操作を練習できます。
Guided Setup lets you practise without m.zh-Hans: 在引导设置中练习功能，不会移动实际窗口。
Guided Setup lets you practise without m.zh-Hant: 在引導設定中練習功能，不會移動實際視窗。

Practise the configured shortcuts inside.en: Practise the configured shortcuts inside the preview.
Practise the configured shortcuts inside.ko: 설정한 단축키를 미리보기 안에서 직접 연습해요.
Practise the configured shortcuts inside.ja: 設定したショートカットを、プレビュー内で実際に試せます。
Practise the configured shortcuts inside.zh-Hans: 在预览中练习已设置的快捷键。
Practise the configured shortcuts inside.zh-Hant: 在預覽中練習已設定的快速鍵。

Try tiling controls on the virtual windo.en: Try tiling controls on the virtual windows first.
Try tiling controls on the virtual windo.ko: 가상 창으로 타일링 동작을 먼저 익혀요.
Try tiling controls on the virtual windo.ja: 仮想ウインドウで、タイル配置の操作を先に試せます。
Try tiling controls on the virtual windo.zh-Hans: 先用虚拟窗口练习平铺操作。
Try tiling controls on the virtual windo.zh-Hant: 先用虛擬視窗練習並排操作。

Review an AI-proposed configuration befo.en: Review an AI-proposed configuration before applying it.
Review an AI-proposed configuration befo.ko: AI가 제안한 구성을 적용하기 전에 검토해요.
Review an AI-proposed configuration befo.ja: AI が提案した構成を、適用する前に確認できます。
Review an AI-proposed configuration befo.zh-Hans: 应用 AI 建议的配置之前，先进行检查。
Review an AI-proposed configuration befo.zh-Hant: 套用 AI 建議的設定之前，先進行檢查。

Check which apps are assigned to each pr.en: Check which apps are assigned to each proposed workspace.
Check which apps are assigned to each pr.ko: 제안된 작업 공간마다 어떤 앱이 배정됐는지 확인해요.
Check which apps are assigned to each pr.ja: 提案された各ワークスペースに、どのアプリが割り当てられたか確認します。
Check which apps are assigned to each pr.zh-Hans: 检查建议的各个工作区分配了哪些应用。
Check which apps are assigned to each pr.zh-Hant: 檢查建議的各個工作空間指派了哪些 App。

Duplicate a profile in the settings wind.en: Duplicate a profile in the settings window and review the workspaces to include.
Duplicate a profile in the settings wind.ko: 설정 창에서 프로필을 복제하고 포함할 작업 공간을 검토해요.
Duplicate a profile in the settings wind.ja: 設定画面でプロファイルを複製し、含めるワークスペースを確認します。
Duplicate a profile in the settings wind.zh-Hans: 在设置窗口中复制配置方案，并检查要包含的工作区。
Duplicate a profile in the settings wind.zh-Hant: 在設定視窗中複製設定組合，並檢查要包含的工作空間。

Open Duplicate from a profile’s context.en: Open Duplicate from a profile’s context menu.
Open Duplicate from a profile’s context.ja: プロファイルを右クリックして、複製を選びます。
Open Duplicate from a profile’s context.zh-Hans: 右键单击配置方案，选择复制。
Open Duplicate from a profile’s context.zh-Hant: 在設定組合上按右鍵，選擇複製。

Choose the workspaces and settings to in.en: Choose the workspaces and settings to include.
Choose the workspaces and settings to in.ja: 複製するワークスペースと設定を選べます。
Choose the workspaces and settings to in.zh-Hans: 选择要复制的工作区和设置。
Choose the workspaces and settings to in.zh-Hant: 選擇要複製的工作空間與設定。

The new profile can be edited independen.en: The new profile can be edited independently.
The new profile can be edited independen.ko: 새 프로필은 원본과 별개로 편집할 수 있어요.
The new profile can be edited independen.ja: 新しいプロファイルは、元の構成とは別に編集できます。
The new profile can be edited independen.zh-Hans: 新配置方案可以独立于原方案进行编辑。
The new profile can be edited independen.zh-Hant: 新的設定組合可以獨立於原組合進行編輯。

Copy settings between workspaces.ja: ワークスペース間で設定をコピー
Copy settings between workspaces.zh-Hans: 在工作区之间复制设置
Copy settings between workspaces.zh-Hant: 在工作空間之間複製設定

Use Copy from to review another workspac.en: Use Copy from to review another workspace’s apps and settings, then apply the selected changes.
Use Copy from to review another workspac.ko: 다른 작업 공간에서 복사할 앱과 설정을 검토한 뒤 선택한 변경을 적용해요.
Use Copy from to review another workspac.ja: 別のワークスペースのアプリと設定を確認し、選んだ変更を適用します。
Use Copy from to review another workspac.zh-Hans: 检查另一个工作区的应用和设置，然后应用所选更改。
Use Copy from to review another workspac.zh-Hant: 檢查另一個工作空間的 App 與設定，再套用選取的變更。

COPY WORKSPACE SETTINGS.ja: ワークスペース設定のコピー

Choose the workspace whose settings you.en: Choose the workspace whose settings you want to copy.
Choose the workspace whose settings you.ja: 設定のコピー元にするワークスペースを選びます。
Choose the workspace whose settings you.zh-Hans: 选择要从中复制设置的工作区。
Choose the workspace whose settings you.zh-Hant: 選擇要從中複製設定的工作空間。

Review the changes before copying them i.en: Review the changes before copying them into this workspace.
Review the changes before copying them i.ko: 현재 작업 공간에 복사할 변경 내용을 먼저 확인해요.
Review the changes before copying them i.ja: 今のワークスペースへコピーする変更を、適用前に確認できます。
Review the changes before copying them i.zh-Hans: 复制到当前工作区前，先检查更改内容。
Review the changes before copying them i.zh-Hant: 複製至目前工作空間前，先檢查變更內容。

The selected apps and settings are now c.en: The selected apps and settings are now copied.
The selected apps and settings are now c.ko: 선택한 앱과 설정이 현재 작업 공간에 복사됐어요.
The selected apps and settings are now c.ja: 選んだアプリと設定が、今のワークスペースにコピーされました。
The selected apps and settings are now c.zh-Hans: 所选应用和设置已复制到当前工作区。
The selected apps and settings are now c.zh-Hant: 選取的 App 與設定已複製至目前的工作空間。

Use shortcuts to select neighboring wind.en: Use shortcuts to select neighboring windows and move the pointer, or select windows by hovering.
Use shortcuts to select neighboring wind.ko: 단축키로 이웃한 창을 선택하고 포인터도 함께 옮겨요. 마우스를 창 위에 올려 선택하는 방법도 보여줘요.
Use shortcuts to select neighboring wind.ja: ショートカットで隣のウインドウを選び、ポインタも移動します。マウスを重ねて選ぶ方法も紹介します。
Use shortcuts to select neighboring wind.zh-Hans: 用快捷键选择相邻窗口并移动鼠标指针，也可以将指针移入窗口来选中它。
Use shortcuts to select neighboring wind.zh-Hant: 用快速鍵選擇相鄰視窗並移動滑鼠游標，也可以將游標移入視窗來選取它。
